launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.name: Julia Davis Rose Garden
launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.sourceLabel: City of Boise Parks and Recreation
launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.summary: Julia Davis Rose Garden is the park's formal public rose garden near Capitol Boulevard, with seasonal beds, paths, benches, and the Julia Davis memorial.
launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.cost: Ordinary garden access is free; reservations, commercial photography, permitted ceremonies, and nearby ticketed attractions can cost separately.
launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.hours: The outdoor garden follows Julia Davis Park's sunrise-to-sunset hours. Blooms are seasonal, and maintenance, reservations, events, smoke, flooding, or severe weather can affect access.
launch-id-boise-julia-davis-park.needToKnow: Use the exact garden pin rather than a museum or zoo entrance. Stay on paths, do not pick flowers, give reserved ceremonies and maintenance crews room, and do not assume the nearby museums or Zoo Boise share park hours.

launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.name: Red Wagon
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.summary: The Childhood Express Red Wagon is a 12-foot-high interactive sculpture whose handle doubles as a slide near Riverfront Park's south side.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.cost: Playing on and viewing the Red Wagon are free; nearby attractions, parking, food, rentals, and events can cost separately.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.hours: The outdoor sculpture follows Riverfront Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-midnight hours unless an event, maintenance, weather, or temporary safety closure restricts the surrounding meadow.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.needToKnow: This is both public art and active play equipment. Expect children climbing and sliding, supervise closely, keep the landing and handle clear, and use the exact pin instead of searching from the north-bank attractions.

launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.name: Riverfront Park Clock Tower
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.summary: Riverfront Park Clock Tower is the preserved 1902 Great Northern Railroad Depot tower on Havermale Island and one of the park's clearest orientation landmarks.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.cost: Viewing the Clock Tower from the park is free; venue use, parking, attractions, food, and events can cost separately.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.hours: The exterior follows Riverfront Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-midnight hours. The tower is a landmark rather than a general walk-in attraction, and event control or maintenance can restrict its meadow.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.needToKnow: Use the tower as an outdoor meeting point, not as an assumed public interior. The clock is hand-wound and chimes across the park; use the exact Havermale Island pin when navigating between north- and south-bank destinations.

launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.name: Lower Falls
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.summary: Lower Falls is a signed Spokane River viewpoint on the west side of Riverfront Park, downstream from the central islands and near the Monroe Street Bridge corridor.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.cost: The public viewpoint is free; SkyRide, parking, food, rentals, and events can cost separately.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.hours: The viewpoint follows Riverfront Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-midnight hours unless high water, ice, smoke, severe weather, construction, or an event creates a closure.
launch-wa-spokane-riverfront-park.needToKnow: River flow and spray change seasonally. Stay behind railings, keep children and dogs close, expect wet or icy surfaces in cold weather, and use the exact viewpoint pin rather than approaching utility structures at the falls.

launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.name: Duncan Garden
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.sourceLabel: City of Spokane Parks and Recreation
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.summary: Duncan Garden is Manito Park's three-acre formal European Renaissance-style garden, with geometric annual beds, manicured turf, paths, and Davenport Fountain.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.cost: Ordinary garden visits are free; weddings, wedding photography, reservations, and permitted commercial uses can cost separately.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.hours: The outdoor garden follows Manito Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. hours, while gated drives, planting work, reserved ceremonies, and special events can narrow access.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.needToKnow: The display changes with the planting season. Stay out of flower beds, do not pick blooms, and remember that weddings and wedding photography require reservations even when ordinary visitor photography does not.

launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.name: Nishinomiya-Tsutakawa Japanese Gardens
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.sourceLabel: City of Spokane Parks and Recreation
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.summary: Nishinomiya-Tsutakawa Japanese Garden is Manito Park's enclosed sister-city garden, with a koi pond, bridges, stonework, carefully maintained plantings, and quiet walking paths.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.cost: Ordinary garden entry is free; private ceremonies and reserved uses can cost separately.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.hours: The Japanese Garden uses seasonal gated hours that are shorter than Manito Park's 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. schedule. Check the current City parks-hours page before making it the sole purpose of a visit.
launch-wa-spokane-manito-park.needToKnow: No pets are permitted except service animals. The garden is intended for quiet walking; do not feed koi, cross barriers, or assume the gate remains open until the parent park closes. Restrooms are in the nearby parking area.

launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.name: Balanced Rock
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.sourceLabel: Garden of the Gods Visitor and Nature Center
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.summary: Balanced Rock is the park's iconic roadside sandstone formation near the south end of the scenic drive and the P15 parking area.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.cost: Viewing Balanced Rock and entering Garden of the Gods are free; tours, food, purchases, private services, and some programs can cost separately.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.hours: Balanced Rock follows park hours: 5:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. November through April and 5:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. May through October, subject to weather, emergency, event, or resource-protection closures.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.needToKnow: Use the signed P15 parking area and stay on the official path. Do not stop in the travel lane, climb or carve the formation, or walk across fragile soil; the rock and adjacent cafe are separate destinations with different access expectations.

launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.name: Siamese Twins
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.sourceLabel: Garden of the Gods Visitor and Nature Center
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.summary: Siamese Twins is a paired sandstone formation reached by the natural-surface Siamese Twins Trail, with a framed view toward Pikes Peak through its window.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.cost: The formation and trail are free; tours, parking outside the park, food, purchases, and private services can cost separately.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.hours: The trail follows park hours: 5:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. November through April and 5:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. May through October, subject to weather, trail, emergency, or resource-protection closures.
launch-co-colorado-springs-garden-of-the.needToKnow: This is not the paved Central Garden route. Expect uneven natural surfaces, sun, wind, and limited shade; stay on the official trail, carry water, avoid sandstone after wet weather, and do not climb without the required permit and safety equipment.

launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.name: Prospect Lake
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.summary: Prospect Lake is Memorial Park's central recreation lake, encircled by a 1.25-mile paved trail and used for fishing, permitted watercraft, and designated swimming days.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.cost: Walking the lake trail and ordinary park access are free; fishing licenses, watercraft permits, programs, rentals, concessions, and events can cost separately.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.hours: The lake area follows Memorial Park's 5:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. winter and 5:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. summer hours. Water recreation, beach access, and facilities use narrower schedules and can close for water quality, weather, or events.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.needToKnow: There are no lifeguards, and swimming is at your own risk only on designated days. Check same-day water-quality and activity status, keep pets out when algae warnings are posted, and obtain required fishing or watercraft permits before entering the water.

launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.name: Memorial Park Skatepark
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.summary: Memorial Park Skatepark is the park's large concrete skate facility on the north side of the campus, separate from the lake trail and playgrounds.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.cost: Ordinary public skatepark use is free; lessons, organized programs, events, and nearby concessions can cost separately.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.hours: The outdoor skatepark follows Memorial Park's seasonal 5:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. or 5:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. schedule unless maintenance, weather, an event, or a safety closure restricts use.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.needToKnow: The facility is active wheeled-sport terrain, not a toddler play area. Wear appropriate protective equipment, inspect surfaces before riding, follow posted direction and skill-area rules, and keep spectators clear of runs and landings.

launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.name: Memorial Park Recreation Center
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.summary: Memorial Park Recreation Center is the YMCA-operated indoor facility with a pool, fitness room, social and play space, and scheduled recreation programs.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.cost: The surrounding park is free, but indoor pool, fitness, classes, memberships, rentals, and programs can have separate YMCA fees or registration requirements.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.hours: The recreation center keeps its own YMCA schedule, which is shorter and different from Memorial Park hours. Check the operator's current facility and pool schedule before leaving.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.needToKnow: Do not use the parent park's open-now status for this staffed building. Confirm pool availability, program registration, age and supervision rules, accessibility needs, and holiday or maintenance closures with the operating YMCA.

launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.name: Olympic Training Center Velodrome
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.summary: The Olympic Training Center Velodrome is a 333.3-meter banked concrete cycling track on Memorial Park's east side with scheduled public programming and races.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.cost: Viewing the exterior is part of the free park visit; riding, classes, races, programs, and special events can require registration or fees.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.hours: The velodrome is a programmed sports venue, not an always-open public track. Use the current operator schedule for classes, training, races, spectator access, and closures.
launch-co-colorado-springs-memorial-park.needToKnow: Do not enter the track because the parent park is open. Track cycling requires controlled sessions, suitable equipment, and operator permission; verify the public calendar and entry instructions before making it your destination.
